title: ConfirmationResponse
description: The answer to a ConfirmationRequest. 'yes' raises the confidence of the reported fire; 'no' from someone on site lowers it strongly, 'no' from further away a little; 'unknown' or no answer leaves it unchanged.

place.description: Where the person answering is (optional; a crew sends its GPS position).

on_site.description: The person answering is at the reported place (within 500 m).

free_text.description: What the person said, transcribed (translated to English by the voice assistant).
